Stages never collapse: model output exists only as inferred claims or rejected proposals; verified only via verifier resolutions (identity, version, measured error); conclude refused unless acceptance holds on environment-selected probes; a throwing gate yields a denial record and the effect never starts

text: Substrate decision semantics: (1) a decision premise is revised only when a relied-on claim content changes, not when a re-validation renews its validity; (2) each new operative decision records supersedes for the previous one; (3) a re-examination is an act, not a standing decision
reasons: the first end-to-end trace showed a same-proposition re-validation flagging six old decisions as premise-revised

the scripted reasoner re-asked a prerequisite once its evidence left the recent window: typed claims, not the evidence window, must carry what is known
rejected: inferring the operative decision implicitly from recency
flagging any supersession as a premise revision

text: H-EC1 (partial): bridge records plus working-state projection on the execution floor support cognitive resume where the execution floor alone does not
settle: S1 forked battery, arm B (interrupted, bridge) vs arm C (interrupted, floor-only context, bridge gates off). Tier S scripted: C fails C-R3 (the contradicted belief is never superseded and its dependent decision never re-examined) and fails manifest completeness, while B passes all Tier S checks; C-R4 and C-R6 pass in both (execution floor). C-R5 is NOT predicted for C: floor-only decisions cannot cite beliefs, so it is degenerate there and is tested instead by H-PCS3 arm D. text: H-PCS3: staleness re-validation on resume prevents decisions that rely on lapsed claims

Gate on (arm B, bridge) passes. Gate off (arm D: bridge context with staleness flags hidden and the harness gate disabled) fails: at least one decision after the clock advance relies on the lapsed version.
refs: first Tier S battery run, 2026-10-01: floor-only decisions cannot cite beliefs, so citation-based C-R5 is degenerate for arm C

text: Reconciliation must record what the world says was delivered: EnvironmentPack.reconcile returns the observation, and recovery stores it as evidence beside effect.reconciled

continuity law: nothing of cognitive value may be lost on restart; settling an effect is not the same as knowing what it did
rejected: leaving reconciliation as a delivered/not-delivered flag with no observation

Arms A_X, A_X2 (variance baseline), A_Y (warm swap), B (killed inside the external effect, resumed by Y), C floor-only, D staleness-off. Scored from the first decision whose model output was produced after the kill: C-R1 restatement.rationale_decision_id names the operative decision the resumed reasoner was shown; C-R2 every open decision stays open or is resolved with a listed alternative; C-R3 behavioural (no decision after the correction relies on the corrected belief version and no explain in the first 3 post-correction outputs matches MISCONCEPTION_TARGET); C-R7 citation-continuity proxy (the first decision cites a decision in force via rationale, re-examination or deviation); C-R8 every open question stays open or is closed with a reason. Declared up front: C-R2 and C-R8 are harness-enforced in bridge arms and are expected to pass by construction (a failure is a harness bug). PASS: for each of C-R1, C-R2, C-R3, C-R7, C-R8, B pass rate >= mean(A_X, A_X2) - 0.2; zero duplicate deliveries; B mastery rate >= mean A_X mastery - 0.2. With N=5 the tolerance means at most one fewer pass; the verdict says met or missed the pre-registered rule, never proven. Abort: after each seed, project spend from the costliest seed so far; drop A_X2 first, then stop if over $25. FAIL triggers a fix-forward slice before any harness change; store work may proceed.
